# Municipal Ordinance No. 02, Series of 2022 -- Business Permit and Licensing System (BPLS)

**Resolution No. 20, Series of 2022**

## Summary

Institutionalizes the Business Permit and Licensing System (BPLS) in [[Pitogo]] to streamline business registration and improve ease of doing business. References [[RA 9485]] (Anti-Red Tape Act of 2007) on efficient delivery of government services. The ordinance covers application procedures, fees, and administrative processes across 14 pages, establishing a unified system for business permits and licensing within the municipality.

## Key Provisions

- Institutionalizes the BPLS as the official business registration system of [[Pitogo]]
- Streamlines business permit application and renewal procedures
- Establishes standardized fee schedules for business permits and licenses per [[Sec-143-RA7160]] and [[Sec-152-RA7160]]
- Sets processing timelines in compliance with [[RA 9485]] (Anti-Red Tape Act of 2007)
- Defines requirements for new business applications and renewals
- Establishes penalties for non-compliance
- Provides administrative procedures for permit revocation and suspension

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
